steps.title: Prepare Oxygenated Ames' Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the base medium for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.9 g sodium bicarbonate (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #S6014) to a 1L container (glass bottle or flask).
Empty one container of Ames' Medium powder (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #A1420) into the 1L container.
Fill the container with 1L of ddH2O and shake/mix well.
Bubble oxygen gas (95% O2/5% CO2) through the solution.

steps.title: Prepare 10X Ovomucoid Solution (LO)
steps.instruction: Prepare a concentrated stock of Ovomucoid solution.

substeps.instruction: Combine 150 mg BSA (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #A9418), 150 mg Ovomucoid (Worthington Biochemical Corporation Catalog #LS003087), and 10 mL Oxygenated Ames' medium.
Dissolve and adjust pH to ~7.4 using a few µL of 2N NaOH.
Filter the solution into a new falcon tube using a 0.22 um filter to sterilize.
Create 1 mL aliquots and store at -20˚C.

steps.title: Prepare 1X Ovomucoid Solution (LO)
steps.instruction: Dilute the 10X LO stock to a working concentration.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1 mL of 10X LO aliquot with 9 mL of Oxygenated Ames' medium.
Mix 900 uL of Oxygenated Ames' medium with 100 uL of 0.4% non-acetylated BSA stock.

steps.title: Prepare Papain Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare and activate the papain digestion solution.

substeps.instruction: Combine 10 mL Oxygenated Ames', 200 Units Papain (Worthington Biochemical Corporation Catalog #LS003126; e.g., 168 uL for a 44.8 mgP/mL, 26.6 u/mgP batch), 100 uL DNase I stock solution, and 100 uL L-cysteine aliquot.
Filter into a new 15 mL falcon tube using a 0.22 um filter to sterilize.
Activate the papain by incubating the solution at 37 ˚C for 15 minutes before use.

steps.title: Set Up Dissection Area
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and maintain tissue viability.

substeps.instruction: Clean all instruments and workspace with RNaseZap (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #AM9780) followed by 70% EtOH.
Place instruments on a Chux Pad or similar sheet.
Keep the eye immersed in Ames media or Optisol in a container on ice until dissection; process the eye preferably within 6 hours from death.

steps.title: Isolate the Anterior Segment
steps.instruction: Remove the anterior portion of the eye under a microscope.

substeps.instruction: Make a small incision at the pars plana (~4 mm posterior to the limbus) with a razor blade.
Cut circumferentially with curved scissors to liberate the anterior portion from the rest of the eye.
Place the anterior segment in oxygenated Ames' medium.

steps.title: Expose the Trabecular Meshwork (TM)
steps.instruction: Clear surrounding structures to access the TM.

substeps.instruction: Carefully cut the zonules around the lens with curved microscissors to free the lens from the ciliary body.
Gently lift the lens using scissor blades held parallel to the workbench, avoiding puncture of the lens capsule.
Gently peel the ciliary body and iris from the corneoscleral button using forceps.
Trim any remaining large chunks of ciliary muscle from the TM with microscissors.
Note: This is the ideal time to begin activating the papain solution in a 37˚C waterbath.
Identify the TM and insert one prong of Jewelers forceps into Schlemm’s canal.
Grab the TM with forceps and gently pull it out in strips (ciliary muscle and descemet membrane may be included).
Gently scrape the back wall of Schlemm's canal to transfer cells to the papain solution.
Add TM strips to prewarmed, activated papain solution in an eppendorf tube.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 37 ˚C.
Invert the tube every 7-10 minutes to agitate gently.

steps.title: Dissociate Tissue into Single Cell Suspension

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the digested tissue and papain solution for 30 seconds at 500 rcf.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Add 1 mL 1X LO to the tissue and triturate with a 1000 uL pipette.
Filter through a 40 um strainer into a 50 mL falcon tube.
If large chunks remain, return them to the eppendorf, add another 1 mL 1X LO, and repeat trituration/filtration.
Rinse the filter with 500 uL - 1000 uL of 1X LO and collect in the same 50 mL falcon tube.

steps.title: Prepare Single Cell Solution for Loading
steps.instruction: Concentrate and dilute cells for 10X loading.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the 50 mL falcon tube at 500 rcf for 5 minutes (preferably at 4 ˚C).
Carefully remove the supernatant, noting the pellet position.
Resuspend cells in 50 uL - 200 uL 0.04% non-acetylated BSA, depending on pellet size.
Transfer the suspension to a 1.7 mL eppendorf tube.
Count cells with a hemocytometer and dilute with 0.04% non-acetylated BSA to the desired concentration (typically 1000 cells per microliter for 6000 cells recovered).
Perform a cell viability assay if required prior to loading.
